title: Vehicle Schedule Amendments on Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Certificates — Desk Reference
content:
## Subject

A vehicle amendment reports to the ordering state one vehicle endorsement of the certified Cardinal Personal Auto Policy — a vehicle added, replaced or removed — on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate that lists the scheduled vehicles. The amended certificate brings the vehicle schedule printed on the certificate into line with that endorsement.

The vehicle amendment charge is the amount booked for it, once per vehicle amendment, on its transmission. A vehicle change on a certificate that does not list vehicles needs no amendment and carries no charge.

## Condition on the filing's record

A vehicle amendment charge is fixed only after every SR-26 cancellation transmitted on the filing is followed on the filing's record by a reinstatement transmission.

Put the other way round: while the filing's record shows an SR-26 cancellation transmission with no reinstatement transmission after it on that record, no vehicle amendment charge is fixed for the filing.

## What the vehicle amendment records

- one amendment entry on the filing's record with the reason vehicle change, tied to the policy vehicle endorsement it reports;
- one amendment transmission to the ordering state under a new transmission confirmation number;
- one filing charge with the reason amended filing on that transmission, in the amount given.

The filing's status does not change. The customer sees the amendment and its charge on the filing history.

## Invocation

**Tool:** `amend_certificate_vehicles_869f2144` — an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `filing_id` | The filing reference number of the certificate being amended, as returned by the filing lookup for the household | Identifier |
| `endorsement_id` | The transaction reference number of the policy vehicle endorsement (an added, replaced or removed vehicle) that the amendment reports, as returned by the policy transaction history | Identifier |
| `vehicle_amendment_charge` | The vehicle amendment charge to book | USD, non-negative, two decimal places; rounded to the cent on entry |

Each call carries one `endorsement_id`, so one call reports one vehicle endorsement. The tool records the charge it is given; it does not calculate it.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the filing reference number, the endorsement reported, the new transmission confirmation number of the amendment (text beginning with SRT-) and the charge booked in USD with two decimal places. Receiving it means the amendment and its charge were recorded. No other return or error is defined.
